product_launches.description: Lightfield launched an automated CRM migration agent that lets companies move CRM records from HubSpot and other legacy systems into Lightfield in about one hour, automating field mapping and relationship preservation.

overview_description.description: Lightfield is a software company that develops an AI-native customer relationship management platform. Its CRM captures customer interactions from emails, meetings, calls, Slack, and other systems and organizes them into a contextual model of customer relationships, accounts, opportunities, and contacts. The platform uses AI agents to perform tasks such as account research, meeting preparation, opportunity qualification, follow-ups, pipeline generation, and customer outreach. Its data model maintains the current state of CRM records as well as the history of changes and interactions over time. Lightfield also provides tools for building agents, automations, and workflows using natural-language prompts, APIs, MCP, and a command-line interface. The platform supports data migration from existing CRM systems and can operate alongside systems such as Salesforce and HubSpot through two-way synchronization.

about_short_description.short_description: Lightfield is a software company that develops an AI-native customer relationship management platform that captures customer interactions.

product.name: Lightfield AI-native CRM
product.description: A cloud-based CRM that captures customer interactions, maintains contact and deal context, and uses AI agents to manage pipeline work, answer business questions, and generate follow-ups.

product.name: Pipeline Generation
product.description: An AI-driven pipeline generation capability that prioritizes target accounts, enriches prospect data, identifies warm-introduction paths, and supports personalized outbound campaigns.

product.name: Sales Assistant
product.description: An AI sales assistant that answers pipeline questions, prepares users for meetings, extracts next steps, drafts follow-ups, and helps update CRM records from customer conversations.

product.name: Data Capture
product.description: An automated CRM data-capture capability that collects interaction context, creates and updates records, enriches missing information, and keeps customer data current without manual entry.

product.name: Meeting Recorder
product.description: A built-in meeting recording and transcription tool that captures customer calls, produces summaries, and turns conversations into searchable context and follow-up actions.

product.name: Natural Language Agent Builder
product.description: A prompt-based builder for creating CRM agents and automations that use business knowledge, reusable skills, APIs, and MCP connections to perform go-to-market tasks.
